name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
summary: An MCP toolset for reverse engineering binaries, applications, and runtime behavior, designed to be used by supported coding agents.

license.verification: README badge and repository license should be rechecked against pinned release

dependencies.reason: REA setup and npm package runner
REA registers MCP tools and workflow instructions with a supported agent
Only for relevant native/binary analysis workflows; verify per workflow
Required by Ghidra, not a universal REA prerequisite

notes: The upstream quick start requires Node.js and npm.
REA setup modifies supported agent configuration and adds MCP/workflow instructions.
Upstream states that setup presents changes for approval and backs up existing configuration.
Run package acquisition from a trusted directory outside the target project.
Keep the package-runner cache entry available when setup records that runtime path.
Restart the target agent after setup.
install.reason: JARVIS must first implement command preview, user approval, config backup/restore, and a tested macOS adapter.

cost.modelsAndProviders: may require a separately configured agent/model provider; usage may incur fees

permissionsToReview: network access for package acquisition and configured providers
